main_text.p: עֵדָה [?] f. Teftis,fœminine, Teftimonium : וְעֵדָה הַמַּצֵּבָה [?] Et teftis hæc ftatua, Gen.31.52. לְעֵדָה In teftimonium, Gen. 21.30. vide עַד : Plural. עֵדוּת Teftimonia, Deuter.4.45. Aff. עֵדָתִי Teftimonia ejus, Pfalm.119.2. Et cum Affixo fingulari, וְעֵדָתִי Et teftimonia meum, td est, Teftimonia mea fingula, eorum unumquodq;, Pfal.132.12.

עֵדוּת [?] f. Idem, Pfal.19.8. בְּאֹהֶל הָעֵדוּת In tabernaculo testimonii, Num.17.7. אֶת הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת הָעֵדוֹת Coronam & testimonium, 2.Reg.11.12. i.e. librum Legis, juxta Deut.17.18. Kimchi & R.Levi. Plural. cum ı mobili & Aff. עֵדוֹתָיו Testimonia ejus, 2.Reg.17.15. עֵדוֹתֶיךָ Testimoniorum tuorum, Psal.119.14. vide Masoram ad ista loca.

עוֹד Adhuc,Amplius,Deinceps : בְּעוֹד In adhuc,Intra, Quum adhuc,Dum adhuc,Tantisperdum : Bis absq; ı scribitur, בְּעַד Tantisper dum, Psal.39.2. בְּעַד Dum adhuc, Jer.15.9. עוֹדֶנּוּ Quamdiu, Job.27.3. עוֹדֶנּוּ Adhuc ille, Gen.18.22. עוֹדְךָ Adhuc tu, מֵעוֹדְךָ Ex quo tu : בְּעוֹדִי Quum adhuc ego,scil. super sum, Quamdiu superstes futurus sum : מֵעוֹדִי Ex quo die vel tempore sum, Quamdiu superstes sum vel sui : מֵעוֹדֵנִי חִי Tantisper dum ego vixero, 1.Sam.20.14. vel ח' בְּעוֹדֵנִי Deut.31.27, הָעוֹדָם חַיִּים An adhuc ipsi vivi sint, Exod.4.18. עוֹדִינָה Adhuc nobis, scil. superstitibus, Thr.4.17. pro נוֹ. Chald. עוֹד Adhuc, Dan.4.28.

עָוַת [?] Inique,Perversè egit: Præt. וַיַּעֲוּ Et perversè egimus, Dan.9.5, עָוְתָה Perversè egit, Esth.1.16. Niph. נַעֲוָה Perverti, Distorqueri, Contorqueri. Præt. נַעֲוֵיתִי Contorqueor, Jer.21.8. Part.Constr. לַנַּעֲוָה Perversus animo, Prov.12.8. Fœmin.Constr. בֶּן נָעַוָה Fili perversæ rebelliône, 1.Sam.20.30. Pih.Præter. וְעִוֵּת Et pervertet, Jesa.24.1. Pyh.Particip. מְעֻוָּת Perversum, Eccles.1.15. Ex Hiph.Præter. הֶעֱוָה Inique egit, 2.Sam.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and vocalised forms are copied from a small, fairly worn print and are marked [?] where the points or letters are doubtful; check them against the scan. The first headword line is partly illegible at the left edge. The Hebrew in the entries beginning "Inique" and "Tantisperdum" is uncertain in its vowel points. A stray slash mark near the foot of the page is not text and is left out.
